text:
marta: quick sync: steering committee wants a single v1 cut for console observability that we can ship in the next beta. choices are dashboards-heavy (fast finance value) vs trace-first (deep SRE/forensics). need concrete launch criteria + rollout plan today.

owen: finance keeps pushing for exportable tenant billing, but ops keep saying traces are critical for incidents. i'm leaning dashboards-first but with runtime trace hooks so we can zoom in when needed.

kay: technical note: tracing-by-default kills p95 and storage. we should design flow: dashboards + on-demand trace capture hooked to alerts and manual sampling ramp. that keeps steady-state cheap.

diego: propose three minimal pillars for v1: (1) per-route cost table + CSV export, (2) error slices with quick drilldowns, (3) on-alert trace capture (no global full traces). acceptance gates around perf, cost, and accuracy.

sara: to be precise, suggested acceptance criteria: 
- per-route cost view showing top 50 routes and percent of total cost exported to CSV (columns: route, tokens, est_usd, tenant_id_opt, uncertainty_pct)
- error analytics: slice by model, route, tenant with delta vs baseline and ability to tag an incident
- trace-on-alert: when error spike or regression alert fires capture up to 25 traces from the alert window and expose trace_id in the slice rows
- runtime controls: per-tenant tracing toggle and global emergency-off flag
- perf: canary p95 latency impact <4% and p50 <2%
- infra: projected storage delta for beta cohort <= 12%

marta: sampling config proto that balances cost and triage:
```
tracing:
  global_sampling: 0.001     # 0.1% baseline
  alert_capture_sampling: 1.0 # 100% when alert fires
  error_sampling: 1.0        # always capture errors
  per_tenant_max_daily_traces: 200
```
this keeps steady-state small and guarantees context on incidents.

owen: we also need to clearly mark any exported billing numbers as ESTIMATED when allocation heuristics are used. suggested heuristics: proportional-by-invocations OR cache-aware weighted allocation. UI shows method used and an uncertainty score.

kay: runtime hooks required: inject tenant_id, emit `invocation.weight`, `cache_hit` boolean, and add span tags `tenant.id`, `route`, `model.family`. also a lightweight metric `cost.estimated_usd` per invocation for fast aggregation.

diego: rollout plan: internal canary 3% for 7 days -> monitor p95, alerts/day, storage delta, and allocation error on synthetic ground-truth -> expand to 25% for 14 days -> GA. comms: mark beta tenants and provide advice on disabling tracing for specific tenants if needed.

sara: UX scope: two templates (Billing, SRE). Billing template shows CSV export, allocation method, uncertainty badge, and a download button. SRE template shows error slices, trace_id links and a "capture more" button that can request additional trace samples for a live window.

owen: infra-bot bench note: staging run 40k rps with global_sampling=0.001 -> trace volume ~22GB/day; p95 +2.1%. alert_capture adds ~5GB/day for a 5% canary cohort based on simulated alert frequency.

infra-bot: bench summary saved: https://bench.redwood/obs/v1-run-2199. projection: 12% infra delta for beta cohort at config above.

kay: questions about privacy/compliance for private deployments: we must ensure trace capture respects PII redaction rules and KMS keys for private clusters; add that to acceptance.

sara: add to launch check: PII redaction verified for traces (redaction filters run on span attributes), and RBAC: only allowed roles can download tenant CSVs.

marta: engineering asks: 2 backend (aggregation + allocation), 1 infra (bench + canary), 1 frontend (templates + trace modal). estimate 3 sprints for canary. also request a small synthetic harness that validates allocation error <20% for 80% of tenants under mixed cache scenarios.

diego: simple export schema proposal for CSV columns: `route, tenant_id (opt), tokens, est_usd, allocation_method, uncertainty_pct, time_window, notes` and a consistent timezone for billing. keep fields stable for downstream consumption.

owen: ticket created: https://tracker/redwood/PRD-1201 "obs: dashboards-first w/ on-alert trace capture + billing exports" assignees: kay, diego, sara.

marta: final risk checklist before we lock:
- perf: canary p95 delta <4%
- cost: infra delta <=15% for beta cohort
- accuracy: allocation uncertainty flagged and doc'ed; synthetic validation <20% error for 80% tenants
- compliance: PII redaction & RBAC in place for private deploys
- ops: runtime toggle + global emergency-off tested

sara: I'll draft the acceptance tests and the playbook for triage (who owns a billing dispute vs SRE incident).

diego: can we add a short fallback: if alert rate > X/day we'll throttle alert_capture_sampling to 10% to avoid storage spikes.

kay: yes add throttling policy and an ops dashboard showing trace ingestion rates and projected spend.

deploy-bot: Created PRD: https://tracker/redwood/PRD-1201 (linked checklist updated).

marta: ok locking this decision: dashboards-first with on-alert trace capture and estimated tenant exports. i'll update roadmap and add launch criteria to the sprint ticket. speak now or plan locks at EOD. :lock:
